evidence.text: The Commons character category lists “Shuowen Seal Radical 157.svg” as a 640 × 640 file under 号. A separate Commons seal-script category maps radical 157 to 号 and says these images are derived from Shuowen small-seal forms; that category cautions that mappings are approximate and may change. This supports it as a candidate Shuowen-style seal glyph, not as an ancient artifact image.
